# `orders` — what is true now

### Cancelling an order

An order can be cancelled until it ships, and is refunded in full.
→ [ADR-0003](../../decisions/0003-cancellation-refunds-in-full.md)

### Late messages

A retried message that arrives late is never applied.
→ [ADR-0002](../../decisions/0002-late-message-is-never-applied.md#decision)
